title: Printmaking: Folded Book with Printed Cover
summary: Printmaking: Folded Book with Printed Cover
description: Register Here! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. Thursday, October 2, 2025 6:30 – 9:00 pm | Ages 16+ Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio B 50 Victoria Street, Aurora In this workshop students will carve a lino block to create an image for the cover of their own handmade book. Students will learn how to carve lino, how to create a multi page book from one piece of paper, and how to print and add your unique cover to the book. Personal materials to bring, Image of your choice for a 4”x6” carving, Apron or wear old clothes, Folder to bring wet prints home. All project tools and materials are provided for a $10.00 material fee that will be collected at the beginning of the class.
